ddl.name: events_dates
ddl.value: "ends_at" IS NULL OR "starts_at" IS NULL OR "ends_at" >= "starts_at"

ddl.name: event_ticket_types_description_json
ddl.value: "description_json" IS NULL OR (json_valid("description_json") AND json_type("description_json") = 'object' AND length("description_json") <= 8192)

ddl.name: event_ticket_types_key
ddl.value: length("key") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "key" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "key" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'

ddl.name: registration_contacts_shape
ddl.value:
(
        "kind" = 'email'
        AND "email_address" IS NOT NULL
        AND "email_normalized" IS NOT NULL
        AND "phone_number" IS NULL
        AND "phone_normalized" IS NULL
        AND "address_line1" IS NULL
        AND "address_line2" IS NULL
        AND "city" IS NULL
        AND "province" IS NULL
        AND "postal_code" IS NULL
        AND "country" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "kind" = 'phone'
        AND "phone_number" IS NOT NULL
        AND "phone_normalized" IS NOT NULL
        AND "email_address" IS NULL
        AND "email_normalized" IS NULL
        AND "address_line1" IS NULL
        AND "address_line2" IS NULL
        AND "city" IS NULL
        AND "province" IS NULL
        AND "postal_code" IS NULL
        AND "country" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "kind" = 'mail'
        AND "address_line1" IS NOT NULL
        AND "city" IS NOT NULL
        AND "province" IS NOT NULL
        AND "postal_code" IS NOT NULL
        AND "country" IS NOT NULL
        AND "email_address" IS NULL
        AND "email_normalized" IS NULL
        AND "phone_number" IS NULL
        AND "phone_normalized" IS NULL
      )
